//: Four groups, in the order you reach for them:
Run    — start something (dev loop, or the installed app)
Ship   — publish this repo's committed HEAD into the installed app

tasks.label: Run: dev server (hot reload, :4319)
tasks.detail: The hot-reload dev instance. Independent of the installed app on :4318, so both can run at once.

tasks.label: Run: open the installed app
tasks.detail: Start the installed payload if it isn't up, then open it in its own PWA window.

tasks.label: Run: stop the installed app
tasks.detail: Graceful teardown — stops every agent and subApp. Required before publishing.

tasks.label: Ship: publish HEAD to the installed app
tasks.detail: Build this repo's COMMITTED HEAD into %LOCALAPPDATA%\claude-manager\app. Refuses to run while the app is up; rolls back if the build fails.

tasks.label: Ship: publish — dry run
tasks.detail: Show which sha would be published and whether the dev tree is dirty. Writes nothing.

tasks.label: Set up: Start-menu shortcut
tasks.detail: Point a Start-menu shortcut at the launcher (add --desktop for a Desktop one too). Re-run after the first publish.

tasks.label: Set up: migrate .data -> AppData (dry run)
tasks.detail: Preview the one-time split of a single-root .data store into data/ + config/. Copies only; never deletes the source.
